description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability twice by paying {G}{G}{U}{U}: this turn, each creature you control will enter the battlefield with four additional +1/+1 counters.
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {2}{G}{U}.
Crystalline Crawler enters the battlefield with eight +1/+1 counters.
Activate the first activated ability of any Crystalline Crawlers eight times by remove eight +1/+1 counters from them, adding eight mana of any color.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Crystalline Crawler, each with four +1/+1 counters and haste.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
